description: This file defines API routes for managing attendees of events, including registration, listing, and removal. It leverages FastAPI and SQLAlchemy for database interaction and web API creation.

methods.name: Event _get_event_or_404(db: Session, event_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches an event by ID, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: add_attendee( event_id: int, payload: AttendeeCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Registers a new attendee for an event, enforcing capacity and email uniqueness.

methods.name: list_attendees( event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), skip: int = Query(default=0, ge=0), limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100), )
methods.description: Lists attendees for an event with pagination support.

methods.name: remove_attendee( event_id: int, attendee_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Removes an attendee from an event.
